_comment: PTE-TEL-004 field map. Overrides ONLY column wiring, which the freeze protocol explicitly permits. No threshold, taxonomy, verdict logic or frozen .py file is affected. Fields deliberately LEFT UNRESOLVED: 'wkt' (bay geometry must not enable a bay-level join; assert_no_bay_level_join guards this), 'pcnReference' (the only candidate column is socrata_id, a Socrata internal row id, and mapping it as a PCN reference would assert provenance the publisher does not claim), and 'parkingRestriction' (genuinely absent from the PCN dataset - it is a bay attribute).
